abstract: Owing to the recent progress of chemotherapy, a concept of surgical intervention to the malignant tumor in childhood needs to be changed. Surgical approach has not always been a sole way to the cure of the disease anymore. I discussed the surgical approach in neuroblastoma, Wilms' tumor, hepatoblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma and malignant teratoma, stressed especially on how to combine surgery with chemotherapy and on intensiveness of surgery. Since most of the children with malignant tumor can be cured and survive, surgeons have to choose the operative procedure, taking their functional quality into consideration.
abstract_ja: 化学療法の最近の進歩により、小児悪性腫瘍に対する外科的介入の概念は変わる必要がある。外科的アプローチはもはや疾患を治癒させる唯一の手段ではない。神経芽腫、Wilms腫瘍、肝芽腫、横紋筋肉腫、悪性奇形腫における外科的アプローチについて論じ、特に手術と化学療法をどのように組み合わせるか、および手術の集中性に重点を置いた。小児悪性腫瘍の大多数は治癒し生存できるため、外科医は機能的な予後を考慮して術式を選択しなければならない。
